effect: The model lifted and held the glass, showing how muscle activity, control, supply and skin maintenance continue during stillness.

mostWorthwhile.text: Lifting and holding the glass brought the systems together in a familiar action and showed that muscle cells keep using ATP even while the glass is still.

leastWorthwhile.text: Joining the two skin layers was predictable after constructing each one, although it clearly showed their different roles.

surprise.text: The tough outer skin cells are no longer living and are continually replaced by cells deeper down.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the compatible choices and explanations gave each a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would be mildly interested in another chapter if it explored a different everyday action or a new relationship between systems. The final example was useful, though several assembly steps felt predictable.
